component.name: W2R Open Schematics
component.summary: Offline schematic and PCB boardview viewer

description.p: W2R Open is an offline viewer for PCB boardviews and schematic PDFs, aimed at board-level repair work. It renders boardviews with pins, nets and diode readings, cross-probes between the PCB and schematic views, and browses a local library of boards and schematics — including files stored inside .rar/.zip/.7z archives.
Runs entirely locally: no accounts, no cloud, no telemetry.
